name: Eszter Kovács
bio:
Eszter Kovács is a highly organized and driven logistics coordinator with a passion for motorsport that began during her childhood visits to the Hungaroring. Growing up near the track, she became fascinated by the intricate planning and coordination required to keep racing teams running smoothly. After earning a degree in Supply Chain Management from Corvinus University of Budapest, Eszter quickly established herself as a rising star in the motorsport logistics world.

Her meticulous approach to detail and unwavering commitment to efficiency have earned her a reputation for flawlessly managing complex logistical operations. Eszter thrives under pressure and is adept at anticipating potential challenges, allowing her to proactively mitigate risks and ensure that everything runs like clockwork. She excels at optimizing resource allocation, streamlining transportation routes, and maintaining open communication channels between teams, suppliers, and organizers.

What sets Eszter apart is her innovative thinking and willingness to embrace new technologies to improve logistical processes. She is constantly seeking ways to enhance efficiency and reduce costs, making her an invaluable asset to any motorsport team.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair usually tied back in a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Eszter has a determined look, accentuated by her practical hairstyle and sharp features.
